section: S&T institutions - ICAR, ICMR, ICFRE, DRDO, ISRO, DAE, DoS and their mandates
subsections: Commissions - Atomic Energy Commission, Space Commission
ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: The Indian lead institution for the Square Kilometre Array project is
accepted.x: NCRA-TIFR, Pune is the Indian lead institution for the Square Kilometre Array, whose facilities are located in South Africa and Australia.
accepted.tq: Use the project–lead institution pairing rather than the project site.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. LIGO-India — Aundh, Hingoli, Maharashtra
2. Thirty Meter Telescope — Mauna Kea, Hawaii
3. MACE telescope — Hanle, Ladakh
4. FAIR accelerator — Cadarache, France
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: LIGO-India, the Thirty Meter Telescope and MACE are correctly matched. FAIR is located at Darmstadt, Germany, not Cadarache, France.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong location by comparing each project with its nearby site pairing.

accepted.s: The Thirty Meter Telescope project is associated with which one of the following combinations?
o: Mauna Kea and India TMT Centre at IIA Bengaluru
Hanle and MACE Centre at BARC
Cadarache and ITER-India at IUCAA Pune
Darmstadt and Bose Institute nodal centre
accepted.x: The Thirty Meter Telescope is located at Mauna Kea, Hawaii, and India’s TMT Centre is at IIA Bengaluru, with DST and DAE as Indian partners.
accepted.tq: Match the international project site with its Indian institutional centre.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Indian participation in ITER?
o: NCRA-TIFR at Pune is the Indian lead institution
BARC at Hanle is the Indian lead institution
Bose Institute is the Indian nodal institution
ITER-India at IPR Gandhinagar is the Indian lead institution
accepted.x: ITER is located at Cadarache, France, and ITER-India at IPR Gandhinagar is the Indian lead institution.
accepted.tq: Identify the lead institution from a project–institution pair.

accepted.s:
With reference to LIGO-India, consider the following statements:
1. Its Indian site is at Aundh in Hingoli district of Maharashtra.
2. Its Indian lead laboratories include IPR Gandhinagar, IUCAA Pune and RRCAT Indore.
3. It is jointly associated with DAE and DST along with the US NSF.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. LIGO-India is planned at Aundh, Hingoli, and involves DAE, DST, the US NSF and the listed Indian laboratories.
accepted.tq: Test a complete institutional and geographical cluster through multiple statements.

accepted.s: The MACE telescope is notable as the
accepted.x: MACE at Hanle, Ladakh, is described as the highest imaging Cherenkov telescope and is associated with BARC.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive superlative associated with the facility.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly identifies the Indian arrangement for the FAIR accelerator?
o: TIFR is the nodal institution, with DAE holding the entire share
IPR Gandhinagar is the nodal institution, with DST holding the entire share
Bose Institute is the nodal institution, with DST and DAE sharing participation equally
IUCAA is the nodal institution, with DST and DAE sharing participation in a 60:40 ratio
accepted.x: FAIR is located at Darmstadt, Germany. Bose Institute is the Indian nodal institution, while DST and DAE participate in a 50:50 arrangement.
accepted.tq: Split the option into nodal institution and participation-share components.

accepted.s:
Which of the following are associated with IIA Bengaluru under the Department of Science and Technology?
1. VELC payload of Aditya-L1
2. Hanle Dark Sky Reserve
3. Himalayan Chandra Telescope
4. Kodaikanal Solar Observatory
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four are associated with IIA Bengaluru under DST: the VELC payload, Hanle Dark Sky Reserve, Himalayan Chandra Telescope and Kodaikanal Solar Observatory.
accepted.tq: Recognise a complete institutional activity list and select the inclusive code.

accepted.s: Gravitational waves were detected by LIGO in 2015, while the Nobel Prize connected with this achievement was awarded in
accepted.x: LIGO detected gravitational waves in 2015, and the Nobel Prize was awarded in 2017 to Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish and Kip Thorne.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the event year from the subsequent recognition year.

accepted.s: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) functions under which parent arrangement?
o: Department of Agricultural Research and Education, Ministry of Agriculture
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology
Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health
Department of Defence R&D, Ministry of Defence
accepted.x: ICAR is placed under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture.
accepted.tq: Identify the parent department before identifying the ministry.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Institution)
(a) ICMR
(b) ISRO
(c) DRDO
(d) CSIR

List-II (Parent)
(i) Department of Space
(ii) Department of Health Research
(iii) Department of Defence R&D
(iv) Department of Scientific and Industrial Research

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: ICMR is under DHR, ISRO under DoS, DRDO under the Department of Defence R&D, and CSIR under DSIR.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure institutional pair and eliminate codes containing mismatches.

accepted.s: The Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education is associated with which parent ministry?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: ICFRE is under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC).
accepted.tq: Discriminate between institutions under neighbouring science, agriculture and environment ministries.

accepted.s: The Atomic Energy Commission was set up in
accepted.x: The Atomic Energy Commission was set up in 1948.
accepted.tq: Test the institutional year against nearby formation years.
accepted.sec: Commissions - Atomic Energy Commission, Space Commission

accepted.s:
Which of the following functions are associated with the Atomic Energy Commission?
1. Policy and strategic planning in atomic energy
2. Oversight of BARC, NPCIL and AERB
3. Chairmanship by the Secretary, Department of Atomic Energy
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Atomic Energy Commission undertakes policy and strategic planning, oversees BARC, NPCIL and AERB, and is chaired by the Secretary, DAE.
accepted.tq: Check whether the authority, functions and chairperson all belong to the same commission.
accepted.sec: Commissions - Atomic Energy Commission, Space Commission

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Space Commission:
1. It was constituted in 1972.
2. It is associated with the Department of Space.
3. It is chaired by the Secretary of the Department of Space, who is also the ISRO Chairman.
4. The Department of Space reports to the Prime Minister.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The Space Commission was constituted in 1972, is linked with DoS, and its Secretary also serves as ISRO Chairman; DoS reports to the Prime Minister.
accepted.tq: Use the complete constitutional-administrative relationship rather than a single designation.
accepted.sec: Commissions - Atomic Energy Commission, Space Commission

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Formation of ISRO
B. Formation of INCOSPAR and establishment of TERLS
C. Constitution of the Space Commission
D. ISRO brought under the Department of Space
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: INCOSPAR and TERLS were established in 1962, ISRO was formed in 1969, the Space Commission was constituted in 1972, and ISRO came under DoS on 1 June 1972.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the 1969 and 1972 developments.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: ISRO was established on
accepted.x: ISRO was established on 15 August 1969. INCOSPAR and TERLS had been established earlier in 1962.
accepted.tq: Separate the establishment date of ISRO from the earlier INCOSPAR milestone.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the relationship between INCOSPAR and ISRO?
o: INCOSPAR was formed in 1969 under DoS, while ISRO was formed in 1962
INCOSPAR was formed in 1958 as part of DRDO, while ISRO was formed in 1962
INCOSPAR was formed in 1962 under Sarabhai and DAE, while ISRO was formed in 1969
Both INCOSPAR and ISRO were formed in 1972 under the Prime Minister’s Office
accepted.x: INCOSPAR was formed in 1962 under Vikram Sarabhai and the Department of Atomic Energy; ISRO was established in 1969.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the predecessor organisation, its year and the later organisation.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: The headquarters of ISRO is located at
accepted.x: ISRO has its headquarters at Bengaluru.
accepted.tq: Use the headquarters location as the direct institutional identifier.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: The principal mandate of ISRO is to
accepted.x: ISRO plans and executes space missions. Indigenous defence technology development is the mandate of DRDO.
accepted.tq: Separate the mandates of two major national science institutions.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the commercial and regulatory arms associated with ISRO is correct?
o: Antrix was established in September 1992, NSIL in 2019 and IN-SPACe in 2020 for private players
Antrix was established in 2019, NSIL in 1992 and IN-SPACe in 1972
Antrix regulates private players, while IN-SPACe commercialises satellites for foreign governments only
NSIL was established in 2008 as a Miniratna, while Antrix was established in 2020
accepted.x: Antrix was established in September 1992 and became a Miniratna in 2008; NSIL was established in 2019, and IN-SPACe was created in 2020 for private players.
accepted.tq: Arrange the organisations by their formation years and distinguish commercial from enabling roles.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the LVM3-M6 mission?
o: On 24 December 2025, it placed BlueBird Block-2 into orbit as the heaviest payload ever launched from India
On 15 August 1969, it launched the first MACE telescope from Bengaluru
On 13 January 2026, it carried the first gravitational-wave detector to Hanle
On 1 June 1972, it placed the first Indian satellite into orbit from Sriharikota
accepted.x: LVM3-M6, launched on 24 December 2025, carried BlueBird Block-2, described as the heaviest payload ever launched from India.
accepted.tq: Link the mission designation, date and payload claim precisely.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Samir V. Kamat — Chairman of ISRO
Samir V. Kamat — Chairman of the Space Commission by virtue of heading DoS
accepted.x: V. Narayanan is the ISRO Chairman as of 13 January 2026. Samir V. Kamat is associated with DRDO and DDR&D.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional office-holder distinction between ISRO and DRDO.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: The PSLV-C62 mission was reported as a
accepted.x: PSLV-C62 was reported as a repeat failure in January 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise current-affairs description rather than infer success from the launch vehicle name.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s:
DRDO was formed in 1958 by merging which of the following organisations?
1. Technical Development Establishments
2. Directorate of Technical Development and Production
3. Defence Science Organisation
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: DRDO was formed in 1958 by merging the Technical Development Establishments, the Directorate of Technical Development and Production, and the Defence Science Organisation.
accepted.tq: Test the complete predecessor-organisation list before choosing the coded option.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes DRDO?
o: It is headquartered at Gandhinagar, has about 52 laboratories and regulates atomic energy
It is headquartered at Hyderabad, has about 100 laboratories and conducts agricultural research
It is headquartered at Bengaluru, has about 20 laboratories and plans space missions
It is headquartered at DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi, has about 52 laboratories and develops indigenous defence technology
accepted.x: DRDO is headquartered at DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi, has about 52 laboratories and develops indigenous defence technology.
accepted.tq: Compare headquarters, approximate size and mandate in one institutional profile.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about DRDO:
1. Samir V. Kamat has been its Chairman since 2022.
2. He is also Secretary, Department of Defence Research and Development.
3. A 2020 reform provided industry royalty-free access to DRDO patents.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Samir V. Kamat has been DRDO Chairman since 2022, also serves as Secretary, DDR&D, and the 2020 reform allowed royalty-free industry access to DRDO patents.
accepted.tq: Combine office-holder, dual designation and policy-reform facts in a single coded question.
accepted.sec: ISRO and DRDO - year, HQ, mandate

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with an institution or facility in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: NARL is located at Gadanki. SDSC-SHAR is at Sriharikota, NSTL is at Visakhapatnam and CTRI is at Rajahmundry.
accepted.tq: Eliminate by checking the Andhra Pradesh institution–location pairs.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: The NIO Regional Centre is at Visakhapatnam. The KVK farmer–scientist meeting was held at Karakambadi, Tirupati.
accepted.tq: Find the location swapped with a nearby Andhra Pradesh centre.

accepted.s: The Department of Space memo dated 14 July 2026 concerned
o: upgrading every KVK into an autonomous university
barring resignations of Group-A staff working on Gaganyaan after about 100 exits
granting royalty-free access to all DRDO patents after about 100 exits
transferring ISRO headquarters from Bengaluru to New Delhi
accepted.x: The memo barred resignations of Group-A staff working on Gaganyaan after approximately 100 personnel had exited.
accepted.tq: Identify the policy response from the problem, programme and date.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the firsts associated with Indian science and technology is correct?
o: APSARA was India’s first satellite, and the first KVK was established in Rajahmundry in 1962
APSARA was Asia’s first research reactor, and the first Krishi Vigyan Kendra was established in Puducherry in 1974
APSARA was India’s first gravitational-wave detector, and the first KVK was established in Hanle in 1974
APSARA was Asia’s first space station, and the first KVK was established in Bengaluru in 1969
accepted.x: APSARA was Asia’s first research reactor, while the first Krishi Vigyan Kendra was established in Puducherry in 1974.
accepted.tq: Distinguish two separate ‘first’ facts without swapping the institutions or years.

accepted.s: The KVK farmer–scientist meeting referred to in the Andhra Pradesh context was held at
accepted.x: The KVK farmer–scientist meeting was held at Karakambadi in Tirupati on 24 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the exact event location rather than the locations of other AP science institutions.

accepted.s: The Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) upgrade plan was reported on
accepted.x: The KVK upgrade plan was reported on 10 September 2026. The 14 July and 17 July dates relate to the Department of Space memo and its reporting, respectively.
accepted.tq: Separate closely spaced current-affairs dates by linking each date to its event.
